The '''Massacre of Zo-Ro''' was a show of force committed by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] against students of the [[University of Zo-Ro]] during a peaceful demonstration. The Empire sent [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to stop them and close the University. [[Jin-Rio Akabi]] survived the massacre, leading to her joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="JR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The massacre was mentioned in Jin-Rio's Character Folio included with [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2014]] [[roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beginner Game]]''.<ref name="JR" />
